TAB KITCHEN/BAKERY
JP NAGAR
TAB, a cafe born from a desire to recreate Bangalore’s serene, calm, warm, and inclusive vibe a cozy sanctuary where one can unwind, slow down, and savour food made with love. Located on the busltling JP nagar 5th Phase long before the road became the epicenter for cafés, breweries some 15 years ago.
A striking reminder of the Bangalore of yesteryears.
TAB began as a simple thought — that a café might feel like home — a cozy sanctuary where you can unwind, slow down, and savour food made with love.Located on the busltling 15th Main, JP nagar 5th Phase long before the road learned its appetite for cafés, micro breweries and traffic. It was never meant to be a destination — just a small place to sit, to eat, to feel like home.
In every sense, TAB is about taking a break a gentle pause from the loud, the hurried, the fast — into a slow, calming, green, and peaceful space that serves delicious, handcrafted comfort cuisine.
TAB has grown through the people who walk through its doors every day — regulars and first-timers, families, students, freelancers, pet parents, and quiet wanderers.
Each person brings a small story with them, and we do our best to return it wrapped in warmth.
Here, no one feels unseen or unheard. That’s our quiet promise.
Over the years, TAB has grown into a quiet tribute to Bangalore’s old soul — whispered through antique wooden chests, the soft gleam of brass utensils, timeworn mirrors, patterned tiles, and the open verandahs of art-deco homes. Almost every aesthetic object at TAB has found its place here from the founders’ priceless family collection. Within the café, these memories linger softly, inviting you to pause, wander, and rediscover them.
